scholarship_title: University of Messina PhD Scholarships, 42nd Cycle (2026/2027)
provider_organization: University of Messina (Università degli Studi di Messina, UniME)

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Not waived. Funded PhD students who live abroad with no Italian income pay a flat EUR 750 per year, plus EUR 156 at enrolment (EUR 140 regional tax + EUR 16 stamp). Unfunded places pay only the EUR 156.

stipend.notes: Gross of the student's share of INPS social security (one third). Paid monthly in arrears for 3 years from 1 Nov 2026, renewed yearly after a positive review. +50% during approved periods abroad. Applies only to funded places; the call also has unfunded places.

additional_benefits: 50% stipend increase during authorised research periods abroad
Research budget per the UniME PhD regulations (amount not stated in the call)

application_fee.notes: Non-refundable entry fee per application, paid by PagoPA (or international bank transfer for residents abroad) by the deadline. Applicants from 'particularly poor' countries (D.M. 176/2026) are exempt; Nigeria is not on that list.

language_proficiency: Language set per course (Attachments 1-15), tested at the oral exam; no certificate stated
eligibility_criteria.age_limit: None for standard places (18-29 only for high-apprenticeship places)

country_specific_notes.note: Nigerian applicants pay the EUR 30 entry fee (Nigeria is not on the D.M. 176/2026 exempt list). If funded and living abroad, expect the EUR 750 yearly contribution.

required_documents.name: Foreign master's certificate
required_documents.detail: With duration, transcript, university, date and final grade, with official Italian or English translation from the issuing university

required_documents.name: Publications, work experience and other qualifications
Research project
required_documents.detail: Where the course attachment requires it

required_documents.name: Videoconference request form
required_documents.detail: If the course allows a remote oral exam

preparation_alerts: Master's degree must be held by 31 Oct 2026 at the latest

Non-EU degree holders who are admitted must provide an embassy-certified translation plus a CIMEA/ENIC-NARIC comparability statement or a Declaration of Value, within 6 months of the course start (Art. 7)
International applicants without SPID must first register an Esse3 account
One separate application (and fee) per PhD course
Read your course attachment (1-15): places, language, oral exam mode and research project rules differ
